articles.title: Russian strike on Kyiv region kills 4, wounds 15
articles.summary: A combined Russian missile and drone attack on Ukraine's Kyiv region killed at least four people and wounded 15, a Ukrainian official reported. This assault occurred following the United States' decision to postpone crucial Russia-Ukraine peace talks. The incident underscores the persistent intensity of the conflict, highlighting the severe impact on civilian populations and the volatile international security landscape.

articles.title: Five killed in Russian strikes on Ukraine as peace talks stall
